tested_target: RS product lower bounds -> alpha/beta totient-ratio lower bounds -> 16p <= 3(2+alpha)(2+beta)(p-1)
result: Naive RS/Mertens product lower bounds do not close the residual tail.
reason: Mertens product lower bounds for arbitrary φ(n)/n decay like 1/log log n; the α/β condition needs nonvanishing product strength. With alpha=f(kN) and beta=f(2kN), the condition fails beyond finite k.
critical_observation: RS Theorem 7 alone gives generic totient-ratio lower bounds; it does not prove the needed structure-specific bound for φ(c2)/c2 in the residual range.
